principles: Derive candidates from A/Q/C state fields; never use derived_transition_reference as a rule input.
Use one opportunity denominator per pattern rather than all decision steps by default.
Retain unclear and weak records as flags; report a stricter sensitivity subset instead of silently dropping them.
Report patient counts alongside transition or step counts so long trajectories do not dominate.
Stratify by disease, prompt hash, schema version, and observed repeat versus switch.
Do not infer stop from the last observed decision step.
coexistence_policy: Patterns are non-exclusive. Store one row per pattern-by-unit occurrence and report overlaps explicitly.

uncertainty_policy.primary: Retain eligible records and flag unclear, uncertain, weakly supported, or not-uniformly-audited records.
uncertainty_policy.strict_sensitivity: Exclude a unit when a field required by that pattern is unclear/missing or either endpoint contains a weakly supported assumption. Do not exclude AQC_P11 merely because its order-support field is weak; that value defines the pattern.

patterns.name: question_reorientation
patterns.opportunity: all adjacent development transitions with source and target question types
patterns.rule: target question_continuity is new/reopened OR source and target question types differ
patterns.denominator: all opportunities with the minimum fields
patterns.interpretation_limit: A type change is evidence of reorientation, not proof that the preceding test caused it.

patterns.name: persistent_open_question
patterns.rule: target coverage is unanswered/partially_answered AND question_continuity is same/refined/reopened
patterns.denominator: all opportunities with the minimum fields
patterns.interpretation_limit: This is an open-question continuation candidate, not automatically a remedy.

patterns.name: limited_study_persistent_gap
patterns.opportunity: transitions after a prior study with recorded adequacy
patterns.rule: previous study is limited_but_diagnostic/nondiagnostic AND target coverage remains unanswered/partially_answered AND question_continuity is same/refined/reopened
patterns.denominator: transitions after limited_but_diagnostic or nondiagnostic studies
patterns.interpretation_limit: Technical limitation and an open target state coexist; causal attribution requires case review.

patterns.name: capability_limited_persistent_gap
patterns.opportunity: transitions after a prior test with recorded test-question capability
patterns.rule: previous capability is partially_capable/not_capable/uncertain AND target coverage remains unanswered/partially_answered AND question_continuity is same/refined/reopened
patterns.denominator: transitions after partially capable, incapable, or uncertain-capability tests
patterns.interpretation_limit: Capability is question-relative and must not be relabeled as study inadequacy.

patterns.name: unresolved_result_followup
patterns.opportunity: transitions with a standard prior result-status value
patterns.rule: previous result is indeterminate/not_assessed AND target coverage remains unanswered/partially_answered AND question_continuity is same/refined/reopened
patterns.denominator: transitions after indeterminate or not-assessed results
patterns.interpretation_limit: Negative is deliberately excluded. Legacy nonstandard spellings enter sensitivity analysis only.

patterns.name: informative_result_question_reorientation
patterns.opportunity: transitions after diagnostic or limited-but-diagnostic positive/negative results
patterns.rule: previous result is positive/negative AND prior study is diagnostic/limited_but_diagnostic AND target question is new or changes type
patterns.interpretation_limit: A new or type-changed question may represent advance or reroute. The rule does not distinguish them and does not establish that the result caused the change.

patterns.name: temporal_requirement_serial_imaging
patterns.opportunity: all adjacent development transitions whose target question has requirements
patterns.rule: target coverage is unanswered/partially_answered, question continuity is same/refined/reopened, AND target question contains at least one temporal_course_or_response requirement
patterns.denominator: all transitions with at least one target requirement
patterns.interpretation_limit: Repeat imaging alone never creates this pattern; the typed interval requirement is mandatory.

patterns.name: assumption_composition_change
patterns.opportunity: all adjacent transitions with source and target assumption type-status multisets
patterns.rule: the multiset of (assumption type, status) differs between source and target
patterns.denominator: all opportunities with nonempty assumption lists at both endpoints
patterns.interpretation_limit: This detects composition change, not semantic proposition identity or causal belief revision.

patterns.name: material_discordance_followup
patterns.opportunity: all adjacent development transitions with a discordance label
patterns.denominator: all transitions with a standard discordance label
patterns.interpretation_limit: Indeterminate discordance is not pooled into the primary rule and requires separate manual sensitivity review.

patterns.name: covered_question_with_further_imaging
patterns.rule: pre-order aggregate coverage of the current question is sufficiently_answered while another image is observed
patterns.denominator: all noninitial steps with aggregate coverage
patterns.interpretation_limit: This is an audit candidate, not automatically an unsupported order; secondary questions and feasibility may explain it.

patterns.name: order_support_concern
patterns.opportunity: all development decision steps with the schema-generation-specific support field
patterns.rule: new schema: question_grounding is weakly_supported/unclear; legacy schema: legacy_intent_support is weakly_supported/unclear
patterns.denominator: reported separately within schema generation; no pooled primary rate
patterns.interpretation_limit: The two support fields are related audit branches but are not semantically interchangeable.

deferred_patterns.name: close_or_stop
deferred_patterns.reason: The current trajectory extraction does not establish that the last observed step is a clinical decision to stop rather than right censoring.

deferred_patterns.name: escalation
deferred_patterns.reason: A modality/protocol/intervention hierarchy has not yet been defined using purely observable attributes.
